53:  * This class facilitates interaction with Coordinator/Overlord leader nodes. Instance of this class is injected

55:  * Usage:
56:  * Request request = druidLeaderClient.makeRequest(HttpMethod, requestPath)
57:  * request.setXXX(..)
58:  * FullResponseHolder responseHolder = druidLeaderClient.go(request)
59:  */
60: public class DruidLeaderClient
61: {
62:   private final Logger log = new Logger(DruidLeaderClient.class);
63: 
64:   private static final int MAX_RETRIES = 5;
65: 
66:   private final HttpClient httpClient;
67:   private final DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;

74:   private AtomicReference<String> currentKnownLeader = new AtomicReference<>();

77:       HttpClient httpClient,
78:       DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider,
79:       NodeRole nodeRoleToWatch,
80:       String leaderRequestPath
81:   )
82:   {
83:     this.httpClient = httpClient;
84:     this.druidNodeDiscoveryProvider = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;
85:     this.nodeRoleToWatch = nodeRoleToWatch;
86:     this.leaderRequestPath = leaderRequestPath;
87:   }

89:   @LifecycleStart
90:   public void start()
91:   {

93:       throw new ISE("can't start.");
94:     }

96:     try {
97:       druidNodeDiscovery = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider.getForNodeRole(nodeRoleToWatch);
98:       lifecycleLock.started();
99:       log.debug("Started.");
100:     }
101:     finally {
102:       lifecycleLock.exitStart();
103:     }
104:   }

106:   @LifecycleStop
107:   public void stop()
108:   {
109:     if (!lifecycleLock.canStop()) {
110:       throw new ISE("can't stop.");
111:     }
112: 
113:     log.debug("Stopped.");
114:   }
115: 
116:   /**
117:    * Make a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
118:    */
119:   public Request makeRequest(HttpMethod httpMethod, String urlPath) throws IOException
120:   {
121:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
122:     return new Request(httpMethod, new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", getCurrentKnownLeader(true), urlPath)));
123:   }
124: 
125:   public StringFullResponseHolder go(Request request) throws IOException, InterruptedException
126:   {
127:     return go(request, new StringFullResponseHandler(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
128:   }
129: 
130:   /**
131:    * Executes a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
132:    */
133:   public <T, H extends FullResponseHolder<T>> H go(Request request, HttpResponseHandler<H, H> responseHandler)
134:       throws IOException, InterruptedException
135:   {
136:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
137:     for (int counter = 0; counter < MAX_RETRIES; counter++) {
138: 
139:       final H fullResponseHolder;
140: 
141:       try {
142:         try {
143:           fullResponseHolder = httpClient.go(request, responseHandler).get();
144:         }
145:         catch (ExecutionException e) {
146:           // Unwrap IOExceptions and ChannelExceptions, re-throw others
147:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), IOException.class);
148:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), ChannelException.class);
149:           throw new RE(e, "HTTP request to[%s] failed", request.getUrl());
150:         }
151:       }
152:       catch (IOException | ChannelException ex) {
153:         // can happen if the node is stopped.
154:         log.warn(ex, "Request[%s] failed.", request.getUrl());
155: 
156:         try {
157:           if (request.getUrl().getQuery() == null) {
158:             request = withUrl(
159:                 request,
160:                 new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", getCurrentKnownLeader(false), request.getUrl().getPath()))
161:             );
162:           } else {
163:             request = withUrl(
164:                 request,
165:                 new URL(StringUtils.format(
166:                     "%s%s?%s",
167:                     getCurrentKnownLeader(false),
168:                     request.getUrl().getPath(),
169:                     request.getUrl().getQuery()
170:                 ))
171:             );
172:           }
173:           continue;
174:         }
175:         catch (MalformedURLException e) {
176:           // Not an IOException; this is our own fault.
177:           throw new ISE(
178:               e,
179:               "failed to build url with path[%] and query string [%s].",
180:               request.getUrl().getPath(),
181:               request.getUrl().getQuery()
182:           );
183:         }
184:       }
185: 
186:       if (HttpResponseStatus.TEMPORARY_REDIRECT.equals(fullResponseHolder.getResponse().getStatus())) {
187:         String redirectUrlStr = fullResponseHolder.getResponse().headers().get("Location");
188:         if (redirectUrlStr == null) {
189:           throw new IOE("No redirect location is found in response from url[%s].", request.getUrl());
190:         }
191: 
192:         log.info("Request[%s] received redirect response to location [%s].", request.getUrl(), redirectUrlStr);
193: 
194:         final URL redirectUrl;
195:         try {
196:           redirectUrl = new URL(redirectUrlStr);
197:         }
198:         catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
199:           throw new IOE(
200:               ex,
201:               "Malformed redirect location is found in response from url[%s], new location[%s].",
202:               request.getUrl(),
203:               redirectUrlStr
204:           );
205:         }
206: 
207:         //update known leader location
208:         currentKnownLeader.set(StringUtils.format(
209:             "%s://%s:%s",
210:             redirectUrl.getProtocol(),
211:             redirectUrl.getHost(),
212:             redirectUrl.getPort()
213:         ));
214: 
215:         request = withUrl(request, redirectUrl);
216:       } else {
217:         return fullResponseHolder;
218:       }
219:     }
220: 
221:     throw new IOE("Retries exhausted, couldn't fulfill request to [%s].", request.getUrl());
222:   }

224:   public String findCurrentLeader()
225:   {
226:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
227:     final StringFullResponseHolder responseHolder;
228:     try {
229:       responseHolder = go(makeRequest(HttpMethod.GET, leaderRequestPath));
230:     }
231:     catch (Exception ex) {
232:       throw new ISE(ex, "Couldn't find leader.");
233:     }
234: 
235:     if (responseHolder.getStatus().getCode() == 200) {
236:       String leaderUrl = responseHolder.getContent();
237: 
238:       //verify this is valid url
239:       try {
240:         URL validatedUrl = new URL(leaderUrl);
241:         currentKnownLeader.set(leaderUrl);
242: 
243:         // validatedUrl.toString() is returned instead of leaderUrl or else teamcity build fails because of breaking
244:         // the rule of ignoring new URL(leaderUrl) object.
245:         return validatedUrl.toString();
246:       }
247:       catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
248:         log.error(ex, "Received malformed leader url[%s].", leaderUrl);
249:       }
250:     }
251: 
252:     throw new ISE(
253:         "Couldn't find leader, failed response status is [%s] and content [%s].",
254:         responseHolder.getStatus().getCode(),
255:         responseHolder.getContent()
256:     );
257:   }

259:   private String getCurrentKnownLeader(final boolean cached) throws IOException
260:   {
261:     final String leader = currentKnownLeader.accumulateAndGet(
262:         null,
263:         (current, given) -> current == null || !cached ? pickOneHost() : current
264:     );
265: 
266:     if (leader == null) {
267:       throw new IOE("No known server");
268:     } else {
269:       return leader;
270:     }
271:   }
272: 
273:   @Nullable
274:   private String pickOneHost()
275:   {
276:     Iterator<DiscoveryDruidNode> iter = druidNodeDiscovery.getAllNodes().iterator();
277:     if (iter.hasNext()) {
278:       DiscoveryDruidNode node = iter.next();
279:       return StringUtils.format(
280:           "%s://%s",
281:           node.getDruidNode().getServiceScheme(),
282:           node.getDruidNode().getHostAndPortToUse()
283:       );
284:     }
285: 
286:     return null;
287:   }
288: 
289:   private Request withUrl(Request old, URL url)
290:   {
291:     Request req = new Request(old.getMethod(), url);
292:     req.addHeaderValues(old.getHeaders());
293:     if (old.hasContent()) {
294:       req.setContent(old.getContent());
295:     }
296:     return req;
297:   }

- Added an overload allowing callers to specify acceptable HTTP response statuses.
